tuition_model.notes: Incoming exchange students under valid exchange agreements do not pay tuition fees to the University of Helsinki.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Official UH Living in Helsinki guide states single student monthly expenses average EUR 900-1,250/month (including student housing rent of EUR 450-800/month). Finnish Immigration Service (Migri) visa proof threshold is EUR 800/month.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: Midpoint EUR 1,075.00/month (900-1,250 EUR/month) * 5 months = EUR 5,375.00; converted at ECB 2026-11-13 rate (collected 2026-11-15) 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html) = 5,940.45 USD.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Tuition fees waived. Non-EU nationals must hold comprehensive health insurance prior to applying for a Migri residence permit (EUR 450 online permit fee, partially covered only for Erasmus+ ICM per agreement; UH purchases insurance only for Erasmus+ ICM). Student Union membership (EUR 40-45/sem) is voluntary for exchange students.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/UoHelsinki/2026-2027/University of Helsinki Fact Sheet 2026-2027 Erasmus+ ICM.pdf#page=5

housing_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/UoHelsinki/2026-2027/University of Helsinki Fact Sheet 2026-2027 Erasmus+ ICM.pdf#page=4
housing_availability.notes: Housing via Unihome & HOAS integrated into exchange registration (one housing offer per exchange student; explicitly guaranteed for Erasmus+ ICM, though exact room type not guaranteed; UH pays EUR 260-500 deposit).

housing_notes.value: Applied during exchange registration via Unihome and HOAS apartments across Helsinki (rent typically EUR 450-800/month per https://studies.helsinki.fi/instructions/article/living-helsinki). UH covers EUR 260-500 room deposit (reclaimed post-exchange).
housing_notes.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/UoHelsinki/2026-2027/University of Helsinki Fact Sheet 2026-2027 Erasmus+ ICM.pdf#page=4

host_grants_or_stipends.notes: Fact sheet p.5 notes Erasmus+ ICM organizational support covers insurance/part of permit fee solely for Erasmus+ ICM agreements.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU nationals must apply electronically via Finnish Immigration Service (Migri, http://migri.fi/en/studying-in-finland; EUR 450 fee) immediately upon receiving faculty acceptance (~4-6 wks post-deadline), visit Finnish consulate/authorized VFS in person, hold comprehensive health insurance, and show EUR 800/month financial proof.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/UoHelsinki/2026-2027/University of Helsinki Fact Sheet 2026-2027 Erasmus+ ICM.pdf#page=5
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: EUR 800/mo Migri threshold confirmed via helsinki.fi / migri.fi.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS credit system (1 ECTS = 27 hours work): target full-time load 30 ECTS/semester (60 ECTS/year); strict minimum 20 ECTS/semester.
credit_system_and_load.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/UoHelsinki/2026-2027/University of Helsinki Fact Sheet 2026-2027 Erasmus+ ICM.pdf#page=3

course_restrictions_note.value: Majority of courses must come from one host faculty/programme. Restricted to majors: English Studies, Languages, Politics/Media/GPC, Economics (MSc), Law/IBL/GGL, Psychology. Severe quota (1-2/sem): Medicine (no clinical English in 2027-28), Translational Medicine (Spring only), Veterinary Medicine, Urban Studies & Planning. Fields not offered: Business, Accounting, Engineering, Architecture, Design, Arts, Nursing, Dentistry.
course_restrictions_note.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/UoHelsinki/2026-2027/University of Helsinki Fact Sheet 2026-2027 Erasmus+ ICM.pdf#page=2
course_restrictions_note.notes: Quota tables and language course exclusions detailed on p.3.

campus_type.notes: Four campuses within 10 km: City Centre (Humanities/Social Sciences), Kumpula (Science), Meilahti (Medicine), and Viikki (Life Sciences).

international_support_services.value: International Exchange Services on every campus (studentexchange@helsinki.fi), mandatory orientation week with student tutors, ESN Uni Helsinki, Unicafe, Unisport, Learning Centre Aleksandria, and disability/special arrangements services.
international_support_services.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/UoHelsinki/2026-2027/University of Helsinki Fact Sheet 2026-2027 Erasmus+ ICM.pdf#page=4
international_support_services.notes: Tutoring, ESN, and support services detailed on p.4-6.

nomination_deadlines.value: 2026-27 strict periods: Autumn semester (Aug-Dec) nomination Mar 1 - Mar 31, student registration Apr 1 - Apr 15. Spring semester (Jan-May) nomination Aug 1 - Sep 15, student registration Sep 16 - Sep 30.
